title: Geometric Calibration of Supervised Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18634v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent studies investigate the weight geometry through its spectral structure, which characterizes how the weights transform different input directions. Within this view, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is shown to induce dense updates that perturb the spectral geometry of pre-SFT weights along their principal directions, potentially disrupting the model's prior knowledge. These observations motivate using the geometry of pre-SFT weights as a reference for refining learned SFT updates. We study this perspective as Geometric Calibration and develop SPACE Subspace Projection for Adapted Checkpoint Enhancement), a lightweight post-hoc method that selectively reverts SFT update components within the principal subspace of the pre-SFT weights while preserving those in its orthogonal complement. SPACE is a data-free, training-free method that requires only the pre- and post-SFT checkpoints. We evaluate SPACE on Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Qwen3.5, Llama-3.1

translated_abstract: 近期研究通过权重的谱结构来探究权重几何，该结构刻画了权重如何变换不同的输入方向。在这一视角下，已有研究表明监督微调（SFT）会引发密集的权重更新，沿主方向扰动SFT前权重的谱几何，从而可能破坏模型的先验知识。这些观察促使人们以SFT前权重的几何作为参考来精炼学习到的SFT更新。我们将这一视角称为几何校准，并开发了SPACE（面向适配检查点增强的子空间投影），这是一种轻量级的后处理方法，能够选择性地回退位于SFT前权重主子空间内的SFT更新分量，同时保留其正交补空间中的分量。SPACE是一种无需数据、无需训练的方法，仅需要SFT前后的模型检查点。我们在Qwen2.5、Qwen3、Qwen3.5、Llama-3.1上对SPACE进行了评估。
tldr: 提出轻量级后处理方法SPACE，通过将SFT更新投影到SFT前权重的主子空间并选择性回退其中的分量，无需数据和训练即可校准监督微调，保护模型先验知识不被破坏。
en_tdlr: SPACE is a lightweight, data-free, training-free post-hoc method that calibrates supervised fine-tuning by selectively reverting SFT update components within the principal subspace of pre-SFT weights while preserving those in the orthogonal complement, thereby protecting the model's prior knowledge.
